idea: A calibration/diagnostic study that predicts when (and how strongly) test-time cost guidance helps a frozen robot manipulation prior, across heterogeneous prior types (zero-training retrieval, trained DP at ep0149/ep0199, task-specific Square-DP), and explains why product/gate/temper combination rules over-optimize.
verdict: As a NEW METHOD, calibrated/predictive test-time guidance for diffusion policies is NOT novel: there are direct 2025-2026 neighbors. As an EMPIRICAL class-project/workshop contribution, a cross-prior-type calibration map on Robomimic plus the zero-training retrieval-score-prior case study occupies a defensible niche that the neighbors do not cover.

most_similar_papers.title: LRT-Diffusion: Calibrated Risk-Aware Guidance for Diffusion Policies
most_similar_papers.overlap: Closest threat. Treats each denoising step as a sequential hypothesis test (log-likelihood ratio) between unconditional prior and conditional head; logistic gate calibrated to a Type-I level alpha = a calibrated, risk-aware guidance RULE for diffusion policies.
most_similar_papers.differs: Offline RL on D4RL MuJoCo, single learned policy head; proposes a new guidance rule. Does NOT study retrieval priors, does NOT compare heterogeneous prior types, does NOT give an empirical predictor of lift from prior-quality diagnostics in manipulation.

most_similar_papers.title: PPGuide: Steering Diffusion Policies with Performance Predictive Guidance
most_similar_papers.overlap: Steers diffusion policies using a learned performance predictor = predictive guidance.
most_similar_papers.differs: Proposes a steering mechanism, not an empirical calibration map across prior types; no retrieval-as-score-prior, no finite-coverage analysis.

most_similar_papers.title: DynaGuide: Steering Diffusion Policies with Active Dynamic Guidance
most_similar_papers.overlap: External-model guidance of a frozen DP during denoising; robustness to low-quality objectives.
most_similar_papers.differs: Manual guidance knob; no when/how-strongly predictor; no retrieval prior.

most_similar_papers.title: Calibrated Test-Time Guidance for Bayesian Inference
most_similar_papers.overlap: Shows common test-time guidance is miscalibrated; proposes consistent estimators.
most_similar_papers.differs: Bayesian inference / imaging, not robot control; ally not competitor.

most_similar_papers.title: Test-time Alignment of Diffusion Models without Reward Over-optimization
most_similar_papers.overlap: Names reward over-optimization; tempered SMC sampling.
most_similar_papers.differs: General diffusion alignment, not a manipulation calibration map; ally.

most_similar_papers.title: Difference-Aware Retrieval Policies for Imitation Learning (DARP)
most_similar_papers.overlap: Semi-parametric kNN retrieval IL; closest to demo_1nn.
most_similar_papers.differs: Trains a difference-aware kNN-conditioned model; HRTG uses retrieval with zero training as a score/pull target inside test-time optimization, plus a finite-coverage bank-size law.

most_similar_papers.title: Enhancing Diffusion Model Guidance through Calibration and Regularization

differentiation: HRTG should NOT claim a new guidance/gating rule (LRT-Diffusion and PPGuide already own calibrated/predictive guidance for diffusion policies). HRTG's defensible, non-overlapping contribution for the final report is the EMPIRICAL CROSS-PRIOR-TYPE CALIBRATION MAP: under matched seeds on Robomimic, relate hybrid lift to measurable prior-quality diagnostics across qualitatively different priors (zero-training retrieval vs trained DP at two checkpoints vs task-specific Square-DP), and explain product/gate over-optimization. The retrieval-as-zero-training-test-time-score-prior plus the finite-coverage bank-size curve is the flagship case study not covered by any neighbor.
implication_for_recommendation: The chosen next direction is sound for FINISHING A FINAL REPORT (empirical, grounded, low compute), and is now explicitly positioned against LRT-Diffusion/PPGuide/DynaGuide. It is NOT a top-tier-novel method. Frame as an empirical study + diagnostic, cite the neighbors as related work, and avoid implying a novel guidance algorithm.
